subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt and refresh https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544 for this Channels UI resolver fix, or close it and request a fresh same-repository PR?
rationale: The source-level issue remains valid, but an open linked PR already has closing syntax and blocks a duplicate automated fix lane; its stale base/path and proof state need human handling.

options.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh it onto the current UI path and collect real Control UI proof.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: Leave or close the fork PR and ask for a current-main UI-only resolver PR with focused proof and tests.

recommendation.title: Review or adopt the linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch if maintainers can refresh it onto the current UI path and collect real Control UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the channel UI metadata path and whether the fork patch should be adopted or replaced.
